passage.title: 'Loyal to Whom?', a teacher-written short argument for TGA
paras: Although loyalty is admired, it is not the highest duty of a leader. A leader who protects friends because they are friends will soon govern unfairly. Unless rules apply to everyone, they are not rules at all. Yet duty without loyalty is cold: if a leader trusts no one, no one will trust the leader. The ethical leader holds both, while remembering that justice comes first.

head: Subordinate clause
Main clause
rows: it is not the highest duty.
they are not rules at all.
If a leader trusts no one,
no one will trust the leader.

model.title: Write about Brutus using three conjunctions.

parts.text: Concession: 'Although Brutus loves Caesar, he joins the plot.'
Reason: 'He acts because he fears tyranny.'
Condition: 'Unless Caesar is stopped, Brutus believes Rome will fall.'
Comma rule: comma after a fronted subordinate clause

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: Although Brutus loves Caesar, he joins the plot because he fears tyranny; unless Caesar is stopped, he believes, Rome will lose its freedom.

keywords.def: a clause that makes sense on its own
a clause that depends on a main clause
a joining word: because, although, unless, if

questions.q: Combine with 'although': 'Brutus is honourable. He kills his friend.'
questions.a: Although Brutus is honourable, he kills his friend.

questions.q: Find the condition in the article and explain it.
questions.a: 'Unless rules apply to everyone, they are not rules at all': rules only mean something if they are fair to all.

questions.q: Core: in the portal response box, write a short argument: 'Should a leader put duty before loyalty?' Use three different subordinating conjunctions. Starter: 'Although loyalty matters, ...'
questions.a: A short argument with three correct complex sentences (although, because, unless or if) and a judgement.

questions.q: Extend: underline the subordinate clauses in your argument.
Stretch: link your argument to Brutus in one complex sentence.
questions.a: For example: Although Brutus claims to put duty first, he forgets that justice requires evidence.
A) although Brutus was loyal. It begins with 'although' and cannot stand alone; the others are main clauses.

questions.q: Answer the ponder in one sentence with a subordinate clause.
questions.a: For example: Although promises matter, a leader must break one if keeping it would harm the innocent.
